description: FreeCAD is open with a new empty document and the Part workbench active. Create a Cylinder primitive with the following exact dimensions: Radius=15 mm, Height=50 mm. You can create the Cylinder via the menu Part > Primitives > Create a primitive... (select Cylinder) or via Part > Cylinder. After creating the cylinder, verify the dimensions are correct in the properties panel. The cylinder should be centered at the origin by default. Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/cylinder_model.FCStd' using File > Save As.
